Title: Regulates the sale and marketing of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles
Summary: Regulates the sale of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles; requires sellers of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles to post a certain notice; prohibits deceptive marketing practices with regard to E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles.
LawCode: Add §§391-ccc, 391-cccc & 391-ccccc, Gen Bus L; amd §511-c, V & T L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law and the vehicle traffic law, in relation to regulating the sale and marketing of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles
